title: Ptychographic wavefront characterisation forsingle-particle imaging at X-ray lasers
portal_description: A well-characterised wavefront is important for many X-ray free-electron laser (XFEL) experiments, especially for single-particle imaging (SPI), where individual bio-molecules randomly sample a nanometer-region of highly-focused femtosecond pulses. We demonstrate high-resolution multiple-plane wavefront imaging of an ensemble of XFEL pulses, focused by Kirkpatrick-Baez (KB) mirrors, based on mixed-state ptychography, an approach letting us infer and reduce experimental sources of instability.
